# Abhijnan Acharya

> Abhijnan Acharya builds backend systems, AI workflows, cloud infrastructure, and full-stack product surfaces at Microsoft Xbox Ads.

This site is Abhijnan Acharya's software engineering portfolio. It is intended for hiring managers, recruiters, collaborators, and technical readers evaluating his work.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://abhijnan.netlify.app/): Portfolio homepage and current positioning.
- [About](https://abhijnan.netlify.app/about): Profile, background, and social links.
- [Projects](https://abhijnan.netlify.app/projects): Selected builds across AI workflows, RAG search, backend services, algorithms, and cloud-native product systems.
- [Articles](https://abhijnan.netlify.app/articles): Engineering notes on distributed systems, backend architecture, and software design tradeoffs.
- [Contact](https://abhijnan.netlify.app/contact): Contact form and direct email.

## Key Project Areas

- AI agent orchestration and YAML-native workflow automation.
- RAG search systems using embeddings, reranking, and streamed GPT responses.
- Backend services using Node.js, NestJS, Python, Java, Docker, and Kubernetes.
- Developer tools, recruiting automation, and practical AI-powered workflows.
- Algorithms, pathfinding visualizers, optimization models, and data structures.
